<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=244, initial-scale=1">
<title>Yellow chick wing dance</title>
<style>
html, body {
  width: 244px;
  height: 240px;
  margin: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: white;
}
canvas {
  display: block;
  width: 244px;
  height: 240px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const width = 244;
const height = 240;
const period = 1200;

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xffffff);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-122, 122, 120, -120, 1, 1500);
ref.name = 'reference-camera';
ref.position.set(0, 0, 580);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));
const mix = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;

function smooth(a, b, value) {
  const t = clamp((value - a) / (b - a), 0, 1);
  return t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
}

function spot(x, y, cx, cy, sx, sy) {
  return Math.exp(-(((x - cx) / sx) ** 2 + ((y - cy) / sy) ** 2));
}

function blend(a, b, t) {
  return [mix(a[0], b[0], t), mix(a[1], b[1], t), mix(a[2], b[2], t)];
}

function ramp(stops, y) {
  let i = 1;
  while (i < stops.length - 1 && y > stops[i][0]) i++;
  const [ya, a] = stops[i - 1];
  const [yb, b] = stops[i];
  return blend(a, b, clamp((y - ya) / (yb - ya), 0, 1));
}

const color = new THREE.Color();
function pushColor(target, rgb) {
  color.setRGB(
    clamp(rgb[0] / 255, 0, 1),
    clamp(rgb[1] / 255, 0, 1),
    clamp(rgb[2] / 255, 0, 1),
    THREE.SRGBColorSpace
  );
  target.push(color.r, color.g, color.b);
}

function point(x, y, z) {
  return new THREE.Vector3(x - 122, 120 - y, z);
}

const origins = new WeakMap();
const origin = new THREE.Vector3();

function joint(parent, name, position = origin) {
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  group.name = name;
  group.position.copy(position).sub(origins.get(parent) || origin);
  origins.set(group, position.clone());
  parent.add(group);
  return group;
}

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(920, 640),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      white: { value: new THREE.Color(0xffffff) },
      grey: { value: new THREE.Color(0xd0c8c6) }
    },
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 backdropPoint;
      void main() {
        backdropPoint = position.xy;
        gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform vec3 white;
      uniform vec3 grey;
      varying vec2 backdropPoint;
      void main() {
        float y = 120.0 - backdropPoint.y;
        float haze = smoothstep(201.0, 242.0, y);
        float floorTone = 0.88 + 0.12 * exp(-pow(backdropPoint.x / 105.0, 2.0));
        gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(white, grey, haze * floorTone), 1.0);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>
      }
    `
  })
);
backdrop.name = 'white-backdrop-and-floor-haze';
backdrop.position.z = -325;
scene.add(backdrop);

const surfaceMaterial = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  vertexColors: true,
  vertexShader: `
    varying vec3 tint;
    varying vec3 surfaceNormal;
    #ifdef WING_SHADOWS
      varying vec3 worldPoint;
    #endif
    void main() {
      tint = color;
      surfaceNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
      #ifdef WING_SHADOWS
        worldPoint = (modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;
      #endif
      gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
    }
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    varying vec3 tint;
    varying vec3 surfaceNormal;
    #ifdef WING_SHADOWS
      varying vec3 worldPoint;
      uniform vec4 leftShadow;
      uniform vec4 rightShadow;
      float contact(vec2 p, vec4 shape) {
        vec2 d = (p - shape.xy) / shape.zw;
        return exp(-dot(d, d));
      }
    #endif
    void main() {
      vec3 n = normalize(surfaceNormal);
      vec3 key = mat3(viewMatrix) * normalize(vec3(-0.44, 0.73, 0.65));
      vec3 fill = mat3(viewMatrix) * normalize(vec3(0.64, 0.23, 0.76));
      vec3 back = mat3(viewMatrix) * normalize(vec3(0.15, 0.52, -0.84));
      vec3 bounce = mat3(viewMatrix) * normalize(vec3(-0.30, -0.86, -0.26));
      vec3 light = vec3(0.765)
        + vec3(0.238, 0.225, 0.198) * max(0.0, dot(n, key))
        + vec3(0.126, 0.129, 0.135) * max(0.0, dot(n, fill))
        + vec3(0.211, 0.217, 0.235) * max(0.0, dot(n, back))
        + vec3(0.098, 0.087, 0.075) * max(0.0, dot(n, bounce));
      #ifdef WING_SHADOWS
        vec2 p = vec2(worldPoint.x + 122.0, 120.0 - worldPoint.y);
        float facing = smoothstep(5.0, 46.0, worldPoint.z);
        float shade = facing * (0.19 * contact(p, leftShadow) + 0.28 * contact(p, rightShadow));
        light *= 1.0 - shade * vec3(0.84, 1.05, 1.22);
      #endif
      gl_FragColor = vec4(tint * light, 1.0);
      #include <colorspace_fragment>
    }
  `
});

const plumageMaterial = surfaceMaterial.clone();
plumageMaterial.defines.WING_SHADOWS = 1;
plumageMaterial.uniforms = {
  leftShadow: { value: new THREE.Vector4() },
  rightShadow: { value: new THREE.Vector4() }
};

function hermite(a, b, da, db, t) {
  const t2 = t * t;
  const t3 = t2 * t;
  return (2 * t3 - 3 * t2 + 1) * a + (t3 - 2 * t2 + t) * da
    + (-2 * t3 + 3 * t2) * b + (t3 - t2) * db;
}

function section(profile, y) {
  let i = 0;
  while (i < profile.length - 2 && y > profile[i + 1][0]) i++;
  const a = profile[i];
  const b = profile[i + 1];
  const before = profile[Math.max(0, i - 1)];
  const after = profile[Math.min(i + 2, profile.length - 1)];
  const span = b[0] - a[0];
  const t = clamp((y - a[0]) / span, 0, 1);

  return [1, 2, 3, 4].map(k => hermite(
    a[k], b[k],
    (b[k] - before[k]) * span / (b[0] - before[0]),
    (after[k] - a[k]) * span / (after[0] - a[0]),
    t
  ));
}

function roundShape(profile, shear = 0, axis = 0) {
  return row => {
    const [x, rx, z, rz] = section(profile, row);
    return [x, row + shear * (x - axis), z, Math.max(0, rx), Math.max(0, rz), shear];
  };
}

function loft(group, name, profile, start, end, shape, paint, sides = 96, material = surfaceMaterial) {
  const first = profile[0][0];
  const last = profile[profile.length - 1][0];
  const rows = Math.ceil((end - start) * 1.15);
  const stride = sides + 1;
  const count = (rows + 1) * stride;
  const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const normals = new Float32Array(count * 3);
  const colors = [];
  const indices = [];
  const rings = Array.from({ length: rows + 1 }, (_, r) => mix(start, end, r / rows));
  const angles = Array.from({ length: stride }, (_, c) => {
    const angle = (c % sides) * Math.PI * 2 / sides;
    return [Math.sin(angle), Math.cos(angle)];
  });

  for (let r = 0; r <= rows; r++) {
    const row = rings[r];
    const [x, y, , rx, , shear] = shape(row);
    for (let c = 0; c <= sides; c++) {
      const [s, front] = angles[c];
      pushColor(colors, paint(x + rx * s, y + shear * rx * s, front, row));
      if (r < rows && c < sides) {
        const a = r * stride + c;
        const b = a + stride;
        indices.push(a, b, a + 1, a + 1, b, b + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  const positionAttribute = new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3);
  const normalAttribute = new THREE.BufferAttribute(normals, 3);
  geometry.setAttribute('position', positionAttribute);
  geometry.setAttribute('normal', normalAttribute);
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);

  function writeShape(currentShape, anchor) {
    let index = 0;
    for (const row of rings) {
      const [x, y, z, rx, rz, shear] = currentShape(row);
      const a = currentShape(Math.max(first, row - 0.055));
      const b = currentShape(Math.min(last, row + 0.055));
      const dx = b[0] - a[0];
      const dy = a[1] - b[1];
      const dz = b[2] - a[2];
      const drx = b[3] - a[3];
      const drz = b[4] - a[4];
      const dTilt = a[3] * a[5] - b[3] * b[5];

      for (const [s, c] of angles) {
        const radialX = rx * s;
        positions[index] = x + radialX - 122 - anchor.x;
        positions[index + 1] = 120 - y - shear * radialX - anchor.y;
        positions[index + 2] = z + rz * c - anchor.z;

        const ux = dx + drx * s;
        const uy = dy + dTilt * s;
        const uz = dz + drz * c;
        const vx = rx * c;
        const vy = -shear * vx;
        const vz = -rz * s;
        const nx = uy * vz - uz * vy;
        const ny = uz * vx - ux * vz;
        const nz = ux * vy - uy * vx;
        const length = Math.hypot(nx, ny, nz);
        if (length > 1e-10) {
          normals[index] = nx / length;
          normals[index + 1] = ny / length;
          normals[index + 2] = nz / length;
        } else {
          normals[index] = 0;
          normals[index + 1] = row === first ? 1 : -1;
          normals[index + 2] = 0;
        }
        index += 3;
      }
    }
    positionAttribute.needsUpdate = true;
    normalAttribute.needsUpdate = true;
    geometry.computeBoundingBox();
    geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
  }

  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  mesh.name = name;
  group.add(mesh);
  writeShape(shape, origins.get(group));
  return { geometry, writeShape };
}

function ellipsoid(group, name, offset, scale, paint) {
  const geometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 40, 28);
  const normals = geometry.getAttribute('normal');
  const colors = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < normals.count; i++) {
    pushColor(colors, paint(normals.getX(i), normals.getY(i), normals.getZ(i)));
  }
  geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, surfaceMaterial);
  mesh.name = name;
  mesh.position.set(...offset);
  mesh.scale.set(...scale);
  group.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

function cyclicTrack(frames) {
  const count = frames.length;
  const times = frames.map(frame => frame[0]);
  const values = frames.map(frame => frame.slice(1).flat());

  const tangents = values.map((row, i) => {
    const p = (i + count - 1) % count;
    const q = (i + 1) % count;
    const h0 = times[i] - times[p] + (i === 0 ? period : 0);
    const h1 = times[q] - times[i] + (q === 0 ? period : 0);
    const w0 = 2 * h1 + h0;
    const w1 = h1 + 2 * h0;
    return row.map((v, k) => {
      const a = (v - values[p][k]) / h0;
      const b = (values[q][k] - v) / h1;
      return a * b <= 0 ? 0 : (w0 + w1) / (w0 / a + w1 / b);
    });
  });

  return t => {
    let i = 0;
    while (i + 1 < count && t >= times[i + 1]) i++;
    const q = (i + 1) % count;
    const span = (q === 0 ? period : times[q]) - times[i];
    const u = (t - times[i]) / span;
    return values[i].map((v, k) =>
      hermite(v, values[q][k], tangents[i][k] * span, tangents[q][k] * span, u)
    );
  };
}

const chick = joint(scene, 'yellow-chick');
const body = joint(chick, 'body', point(125, 168, 0));
const head = joint(chick, 'head', point(124, 24, 31));

// Screen height, horizontal center and radius, depth center and radius.
const plumage = [
  [-3.5, 126.0, 0, 0, 0],
  [-2.8, 125.8, 10.0, 0, 9.0],
  [-0.5, 125.5, 21.6, 0, 17.7],
  [3.0, 125.2, 29.0, 0, 24.0],
  [10, 125.0, 34.0, 0, 29.6],
  [23, 125.0, 36.4, 0, 32.8],
  [37, 125.5, 39.1, 0, 35.5],
  [50, 126.3, 44.0, 0, 39.3],
  [65, 127.0, 53.0, -1.0, 45.0],
  [80, 127.3, 63.0, -2.0, 51.5],
  [98, 127.0, 71.7, -2.0, 58.8],
  [119, 126.2, 77.5, -2.5, 65.5],
  [145, 125.8, 83.0, -3.0, 72.0],
  [169, 124.8, 87.8, -2.0, 77.5],
  [193, 124.7, 90.5, 0, 80.0],
  [212, 124.6, 89.5, 0, 77.7],
  [228, 125.3, 85.8, -1.0, 72.0],
  [242, 125.5, 80.8, -1.0, 63.0],
  [254, 125.3, 67.0, -1.0, 51.0],
  [264, 125.2, 43.0, -1.0, 34.0],
  [269.6, 125.0, 17.0, -1.0, 14.0],
  [270.8, 125.0, 0, -1.0, 0]
];

const gold = [
  [-4, [255, 225, 130]],
  [10, [247, 213, 105]],
  [28, [238, 198, 82]],
  [48, [236, 186, 78]],
  [70, [247, 191, 81]],
  [93, [243, 181, 70]],
  [125, [226, 162, 61]],
  [157, [224, 162, 66]],
  [187, [218, 157, 64]],
  [212, [207, 148, 59]],
  [240, [196, 140, 53]],
  [271, [178, 120, 44]]
];

const breast = [
  [72, [246, 192, 111]],
  [100, [253, 207, 145]],
  [131, [255, 219, 174]],
  [161, [255, 221, 181]],
  [181, [250, 213, 166]],
  [202, [240, 198, 139]],
  [230, [219, 168, 92]]
];

function paintPlumage(x, y, front) {
  const forward = smooth(-0.04, 0.86, front);
  let rgb = ramp(gold, y);
  const distance = ((x - 137) / 81) ** 2 + ((y - 149) / 79) ** 2;
  const belly = (1 - smooth(0.15, 1.27, distance)) * forward;
  rgb = blend(rgb, ramp(breast, y), 0.96 * belly);
  rgb = blend(rgb, [255, 231, 165], 0.27 * spot(x, y, 114, 1, 36, 15) * forward);
  rgb = blend(rgb, [210, 156, 63], 0.20 * spot(x, y, 86, 78, 15, 19) * forward);
  rgb = blend(rgb, [213, 153, 66], 0.37 * spot(x, y, 126, 48, 24, 17) * forward);
  const sockets = spot(x, y, 102.6, 25.4, 8.1, 8.8)
    + spot(x, y, 145.3, 20.5, 8.7, 8.7);
  rgb = blend(rgb, [123, 110, 39], 0.57 * sockets * forward);
  const fleck = Math.sin(x * 0.64 + y * 0.48) * Math.sin(y * 0.91 - x * 0.27) * 0.9;
  return [rgb[0] + fleck, rgb[1] + fleck, rgb[2] + fleck];
}

const plumageVolume = loft(
  body, 'continuous-head-and-body', plumage, -3.5, 270.8,
  roundShape(plumage), paintPlumage, 128, plumageMaterial
);

function makeEye(name, x, y, size, tilt) {
  const [cx, rx, cz, rz] = section(plumage, y);
  const side = (x - cx) / rx;
  const front = Math.sqrt(1 - side * side);
  const root = joint(head, name, point(x, y, cz + rz * front + 0.32));
  const direction = new THREE.Vector3(side * 0.84, 0.10, front);
  root.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), direction.normalize());
  root.rotateZ(tilt);

  ellipsoid(root, 'dark-eye', [0, 0, 0], size, (u, v, w) => {
    const rim = 1 - smooth(0.10, 0.76, w);
    const gleam = spot(u, v, -0.30, 0.35, 0.24, 0.22) * smooth(0.48, 0.85, w);
    const dark = blend([17, 16, 7], [69, 58, 21], rim);
    return blend(dark, [111, 103, 55], gleam * 0.56);
  });
}

makeEye('eye-left', 102.5, 25.5, [5.1, 5.7, 2.4], -0.21);
makeEye('eye-right', 145.4, 20.8, [5.6, 5.8, 2.5], 0.14);

const mouth = joint(head, 'mouth', point(125, 43, 35));
const bill = [
  [34.8, 126.5, 0, 36.0, 0],
  [36.0, 126.7, 10.8, 37.2, 4.0],
  [38.1, 126.6, 17.3, 38.0, 8.3],
  [41.8, 126.0, 21.0, 39.0, 12.8],
  [46.0, 125.6, 21.4, 39.5, 15.4],
  [50.0, 125.1, 20.0, 39.2, 15.5],
  [55.0, 124.9, 17.6, 38.3, 13.3],
  [60.0, 124.8, 12.7, 36.6, 8.0],
  [64.4, 125.0, 0, 36.0, 0]
];
const billColors = [
  [34.8, [241, 198, 108]],
  [39.3, [234, 177, 83]],
  [46, [226, 162, 72]],
  [54, [226, 157, 67]],
  [64.4, [229, 170, 77]]
];

loft(mouth, 'rounded-orange-bill', bill, 34.8, 64.4, roundShape(bill, -0.12, 125),
  (x, y, front, row) => {
    let rgb = ramp(billColors, row);
    const midline = 43.5 + 1.7 * (1 - ((x - 125.5) / 19) ** 2);
    const crease = Math.exp(-((row - midline) ** 2) / 1.7)
      * (1 - smooth(15, 22, Math.abs(x - 125.5))) * smooth(0.0, 0.8, front);
    rgb = blend(rgb, [169, 108, 40], 0.22 * crease);
    return blend(rgb, [246, 187, 95],
      0.23 * spot(x, row, 131, 40, 18, 3) * Math.max(0, front));
  }, 88
);

const headTrack = cyclicTrack([
  [0, 0, 0, 0],
  [160, 1.4, 0.4, 10.0],
  [340, 1.0, 3.8, 2.1],
  [500, 0, 9.6, 8.0],
  [680, 1.0, 5.0, 7.6],
  [840, 0.2, 1.8, -0.2],
  [1020, 0.2, 5.8, 9.8],
  [1180, 0.8, 9.1, 4.7]
]);

const bodyPosition = plumageVolume.geometry.getAttribute('position');
const bodyNormal = plumageVolume.geometry.getAttribute('normal');
bodyPosition.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
bodyNormal.setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
const restPositions = bodyPosition.array.slice();
const restNormals = bodyNormal.array.slice();
const headRest = origins.get(head);
const bodyRest = origins.get(body);

function poseHead(phase) {
  const [x, drop, degrees] = headTrack(phase);
  const y = -drop;
  const angle = -degrees * Math.PI / 180;
  head.position.set(headRest.x + x, headRest.y + y, headRest.z);
  head.rotation.z = angle;

  const s = Math.sin(angle);
  const c = Math.cos(angle);
  const positions = bodyPosition.array;
  const normals = bodyNormal.array;
  for (let i = 0; i < restPositions.length; i += 3) {
    const wy = restPositions[i + 1] + bodyRest.y;
    if (wy <= 4) break;
    const t = clamp((wy - 4) / 59, 0, 1);
    const w = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
    const dw = 6 * t * (1 - t) / 59;
    const px = restPositions[i] + bodyRest.x - headRest.x;
    const py = wy - headRest.y;

    const dx = (c - 1) * px - s * py + x;
    const dy = s * px + (c - 1) * py + y;
    positions[i] = restPositions[i] + w * dx;
    positions[i + 1] = restPositions[i + 1] + w * dy;

    const a = 1 + w * (c - 1);
    const b = -w * s + dw * dx;
    const d = a + dw * dy;
    const e = w * s;
    const nx = restNormals[i];
    const ny = restNormals[i + 1];
    normals[i] = d * nx - e * ny;
    normals[i + 1] = -b * nx + a * ny;
    normals[i + 2] = (a * d - b * e) * restNormals[i + 2];
  }
  bodyPosition.needsUpdate = true;
  bodyNormal.needsUpdate = true;
  plumageVolume.geometry.computeBoundingBox();
  plumageVolume.geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
}

const leftWing = [
  [73.0, 68.8, 0, 47.0, 0],
  [76.7, 68.8, 9.8, 48.0, 8.0],
  [83.5, 69.5, 15.2, 48.5, 13.2],
  [93.6, 69.9, 17.8, 47.0, 16.2],
  [103.0, 66.9, 20.5, 44.4, 19.2],
  [113.0, 62.7, 22.4, 41.4, 22.1],
  [124.0, 60.2, 23.0, 38.4, 24.5],
  [135.7, 59.6, 21.7, 34.0, 22.6],
  [146.4, 60.8, 16.9, 30.0, 17.0],
  [154.8, 63.2, 9.5, 27.5, 10.0],
  [158.2, 63.5, 0, 26.0, 0]
];

const rightWing = [
  [60.8, 211.0, 0, 35.5, 0],
  [64.3, 211.9, 5.7, 37.0, 6.6],
  [70.5, 213.2, 8.7, 38.4, 8.7],
  [77.8, 213.3, 12.2, 40.2, 11.2],
  [86.4, 211.5, 13.8, 41.6, 13.7],
  [94.2, 209.9, 15.2, 42.5, 15.2],
  [105.2, 209.4, 18.0, 41.0, 17.3],
  [116.0, 210.5, 20.0, 38.4, 19.8],
  [126.7, 212.0, 19.4, 35.1, 19.5],
  [136.6, 213.0, 15.3, 30.8, 15.1],
  [144.6, 212.5, 9.5, 26.0, 9.6],
  [149.5, 211.4, 0, 24.0, 0]
];

// Each pose specifies the tip, mitten, wrist, broad wing and lower tip.
// The two intermediate poses carry the sweep through its turning points.
const leftPoses = [
  [160, [15, 55], [16.8, 73, 11.6], [20.2, 91, 12.5], [31.5, 111, 24.4], [28, 139]],
  [340, [55.5, 86], [56.9, 105, 18.8], [57.9, 116, 20.2], [56.5, 135, 22], [56, 169]],
  [410, [64, 87], [64.8, 108, 17.7], [61.8, 119, 20.5], [56.8, 139, 23], [60, 173]],
  [500, [20, 91], [22.8, 109, 15.6], [27.6, 128, 15.7], [33.2, 145, 21.5], [33.8, 169]],
  [590, [15.8, 86], [17.7, 105, 12.4], [20.7, 123, 13.0], [31.4, 143, 22.2], [31, 166]],
  [680, [19.5, 86], [21.5, 103, 13.1], [25.5, 119, 14.3], [32.7, 137, 21.3], [35.8, 161]],
  [840, [59.1, 76], [61.1, 94.5, 18.4], [62.6, 105.7, 20.8], [56.1, 126.3, 22.5], [59.3, 162]],
  [1020, [17.3, 73], [18.7, 91.3, 12.3], [21.5, 109, 13.2], [32.7, 128.2, 24], [29.1, 154]],
  [1180, [42, 98], [43.9, 113.7, 17.2], [46.9, 130.4, 19.2], [50.2, 149.1, 22.7], [51.5, 181]]
];

const rightPoses = [
  [160, [150, 77], [154.9, 95, 17.7], [157, 111, 15.9], [184.9, 134, 25.4], [184, 167]],
  [340, [211.2, 72], [212.1, 90, 12.9], [208.7, 107, 15], [210.5, 130, 21], [210.8, 160]],
  [410, [211, 82], [212.8, 101, 13], [210.5, 118, 15.4], [212, 139, 20], [212, 167]],
  [500, [190.5, 103], [188.8, 120, 17.0], [185, 137, 16.5], [194, 155, 24.8], [197, 186]],
  [590, [154, 95], [156.2, 111, 17.5], [159.3, 128, 16.7], [184, 146, 24.8], [186, 180]],
  [680, [174.7, 90], [176.6, 106.8, 17.5], [175, 123.5, 16.7], [192.2, 142.7, 26], [193.1, 177]],
  [840, [211, 73], [212.1, 89.5, 12.6], [208.5, 106, 15.0], [210.2, 128.8, 20.0], [210, 159]],
  [1020, [168.8, 93], [170.8, 111.6, 17.2], [168.7, 126.9, 17.0], [188.3, 146.7, 26], [188.4, 178]],
  [1180, [209.5, 90], [209.5, 107.4, 13.8], [204.1, 124.8, 16.2], [209.8, 147, 22.3], [208.2, 177]]
];

function makeWing(left) {
  const profile = left ? leftWing : rightWing;
  const side = left ? 'left' : 'right';
  const poses = left ? leftPoses : rightPoses;
  const seam = left ? 103.8 : 94.4;
  const first = profile[0][0];
  const last = profile[profile.length - 1][0];
  const stations = [first, left ? 93.6 : 77.8, seam, left ? 124 : 116, last];
  const rest = stations.map(y => {
    const [x, rx, z] = section(profile, y);
    return { x, y, rx, z };
  });
  const track = cyclicTrack([
    [0, ...rest.map(({ x, y, rx }) => [x, y, rx])],
    ...poses.map(([t, ...samples]) => [t, ...samples.map(([x, y, rx = 0]) => [x, y, rx])])
  ]);

  const goldRest = rest[3];
  const wristRest = rest[2];
  const wing = joint(chick, `wing-${side}`, point(goldRest.x, goldRest.y, goldRest.z));
  const hand = joint(wing, `hand-${side}`, point(wristRest.x, wristRest.y, wristRest.z));

  function makeShape(adjustments, wristX, tilt, thickness) {
    return row => {
      const [cx, rx, cz, rz] = section(profile, row);
      const [dx, dy, scale, dz] = section(adjustments, row);
      const x = cx + dx;
      const shear = tilt * Math.exp(-((row - seam) ** 2) / 360);
      return [
        x, row + dy + shear * (x - wristX), cz + dz,
        Math.max(0, rx * scale), Math.max(0, rz * thickness), shear
      ];
    };
  }

  function paint(x, y, front, row) {
    const upper = smooth(left ? 143 : 139, left ? 106 : 100, row);
    let golden = blend([203, 133, 45], [241, 183, 76], upper);
    const shine = left
      ? spot(x, y, 47, 112, 19, 25)
      : spot(x, y, 224, 108, 17, 29);
    golden = blend(golden, [251, 199, 90], shine * (0.36 + 0.20 * Math.max(front, 0)));
    const inner = left ? spot(x, y, 79, 134, 12, 19) : spot(x, y, 194, 116, 12, 28);
    golden = blend(golden, [172, 109, 36], 0.37 * inner);
    const edgeShadow = Math.exp(-((row - seam - 2.0) ** 2) / 17);
    golden = blend(golden, [169, 113, 42], 0.32 * edgeShadow);

    const highlight = left
      ? spot(x, y, 59, 81, 13, 14)
      : spot(x, y, 213, 67, 12, 13);
    let dark = blend([61, 48, 28], [124, 111, 73], 0.74 * highlight);
    const thumb = left ? spot(x, y, 79, 100, 10, 12) : spot(x, y, 220, 83, 8, 8);
    dark = blend(dark, [89, 68, 39], thumb * 0.42);
    const fold = left
      ? spot(x, y, 70 + (y - 86) * 0.19, 88, 2.3, 10.5)
      : spot(x, y, 210 + (y - 82) * 0.39, 83, 4.4, 2.6);
    dark = blend(dark, [37, 29, 16], 0.29 * fold * smooth(0.1, 0.8, front));
    return blend(dark, golden, smooth(seam - 2.0, seam + 2.2, row));
  }

  const baseTilt = left ? 0.30 : -0.34;
  const baseline = makeShape(
    stations.map(y => [y, 0, 0, 1, 0]), wristRest.x, baseTilt, 1
  );
  const goldSurface = loft(wing, 'golden-wing-volume', profile, seam, last, baseline, paint, 72);
  const handSurface = loft(hand, 'dark-mitten-shaped-wingtip', profile, first, seam, baseline, paint, 72);
  for (const surface of [goldSurface, handSurface]) {
    surface.geometry.getAttribute('position').setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
    surface.geometry.getAttribute('normal').setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage);
  }

  const shoulder = ellipsoid(wing, 'rounded-wing-root', [0, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1],
    (u, v, w) => blend([213, 148, 51], [236, 173, 66], smooth(-0.6, 0.85, w))
  );
  const attachment = left ? point(65, 105, 16) : point(191, 110, 22);
  const wingAnchor = new THREE.Vector3();
  const wristAnchor = new THREE.Vector3();
  const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
  const vertical = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const depthWeights = [1, 1, 0.97, 0.79, 0.58];

  return phase => {
    const pose = track(phase);
    const travel = left ? rest[0].x - pose[0] : rest[0].x - pose[0];
    const depth = travel * (left ? -0.43 : 0.67);
    const reach = clamp(travel / (left ? 53 : 61), 0, 1);
    const wristRatio = pose[8] / wristRest.rx;
    const adjustments = rest.map(({ x, y, rx }, i) => [
      y,
      pose[3 * i] - x,
      pose[3 * i + 1] - y,
      rx > 0.01 ? pose[3 * i + 2] / rx : (i === 0 ? wristRatio : pose[11] / goldRest.rx),
      depth * depthWeights[i]
    ]);
    const shape = makeShape(
      adjustments, pose[6], baseTilt + (left ? 0.13 : 0.08) * reach, 1 - 0.10 * reach
    );

    const [gx, gy, gz] = shape(stations[3]);
    const [hx, hy, hz] = shape(seam);
    wingAnchor.set(gx - 122, 120 - gy, gz);
    wristAnchor.set(hx - 122, 120 - hy, hz);
    wing.position.copy(wingAnchor);
    hand.position.copy(wristAnchor).sub(wingAnchor);
    goldSurface.writeShape(shape, wingAnchor);
    handSurface.writeShape(shape, wristAnchor);

    direction.copy(attachment).sub(wingAnchor);
    shoulder.position.copy(direction).multiplyScalar(0.5);
    shoulder.scale.set(left ? 12.6 : 13.6, direction.length() * 0.5 + 7, 10.9);
    shoulder.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(vertical, direction.normalize());

    if (left) {
      plumageMaterial.uniforms.leftShadow.value.set(Math.max(52, gx + 6), gy + 22, 14, 19);
    } else {
      plumageMaterial.uniforms.rightShadow.value.set(gx - 13, gy + 4, 15, 25);
    }
  };
}

const poseLeftWing = makeWing(true);
const poseRightWing = makeWing(false);

const tail = joint(body, 'tail', point(126, 190, -66));
const tailProfile = [
  [165, 126, 0, -77, 0],
  [171, 126, 12, -82, 9],
  [182, 126, 19, -82, 18],
  [194, 126, 24, -77, 20],
  [205, 126, 22, -69, 18],
  [220, 126, 0, -65, 0]
];
loft(tail, 'short-rounded-tail', tailProfile, 165, 220, roundShape(tailProfile),
  (x, y) => blend([222, 166, 65], [188, 126, 44], smooth(165, 220, y))
);

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const foot = joint(chick, side < 0 ? 'foot-left' : 'foot-right', point(125 + side * 27, 266, 16));
  foot.rotation.y = side * 0.12;
  const footPaint = (x, y) => blend([177, 104, 34], [222, 152, 52], smooth(-0.6, 0.9, y));
  ellipsoid(foot, 'webbed-foot', [0, 0, 6], [16, 6.7, 21], footPaint);
  for (const toe of [-1, 0, 1]) {
    ellipsoid(foot, 'rounded-toe', [toe * 8.6, -1.3, 19 - Math.abs(toe) * 3],
      [5.6, 4.4, 10.5], footPaint);
  }
}

const image = new THREE.WebGLRenderTarget(width, height, {
  minFilter: THREE.LinearFilter,
  magFilter: THREE.LinearFilter,
  depthBuffer: true,
  samples: 4
});

const presentation = new THREE.Scene();
const presentationCamera = new THREE.Camera();
const frame = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2),
  new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    uniforms: {
      frameColor: { value: image.texture },
      pixel: { value: new THREE.Vector2(1 / width, 1 / height) }
    },
    depthWrite: false,
    depthTest: false,
    vertexShader: `
      varying vec2 screenUV;
      void main() {
        screenUV = uv;
        gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0);
      }
    `,
    fragmentShader: `
      uniform sampler2D frameColor;
      uniform vec2 pixel;
      varying vec2 screenUV;

      float grain(vec2 cell) {
        return fract(sin(dot(cell, vec2(127.1, 311.7))) * 43758.5453);
      }

      void main() {
        vec2 dx = vec2(pixel.x * 1.06, 0.0);
        vec2 dy = vec2(0.0, pixel.y * 1.06);
        vec3 rgb = 0.424 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV).rgb;
        rgb += 0.115 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV + dx).rgb;
        rgb += 0.115 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV - dx).rgb;
        rgb += 0.115 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV + dy).rgb;
        rgb += 0.115 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV - dy).rgb;
        rgb += 0.029 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV + dx + dy).rgb;
        rgb += 0.029 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV + dx - dy).rgb;
        rgb += 0.029 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV - dx + dy).rgb;
        rgb += 0.029 * texture2D(frameColor, screenUV - dx - dy).rgb;

        gl_FragColor = vec4(rgb, 1.0);
        #include <colorspace_fragment>

        vec2 cell = floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
        float noise = grain(cell) - 0.5;
        float checker = mod(cell.x + cell.y, 2.0) - 0.5;
        float strength = clamp((1.0 - min(rgb.r, min(rgb.g, rgb.b))) * 2.0, 0.10, 1.0);
        gl_FragColor.rgb += strength * (
          noise * vec3(0.030, 0.032, 0.045)
          + checker * vec3(0.012, -0.009, 0.021)
        );
      }
    `
  })
);
frame.frustumCulled = false;
presentation.add(frame);

function render(t) {
  const cycle = period * 1000;
  const phase = ((Math.round(t * 1000) % cycle + cycle) % cycle) / 1000;
  poseHead(phase);
  poseLeftWing(phase);
  poseRightWing(phase);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(image);
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
  renderer.setRenderTarget(null);
  renderer.render(presentation, presentationCamera);
}

const characters = [chick];
render(0);
window.nwb = { scene, renderer, cameras: { ref }, characters, render, ready: true };
</script>
